objective_pt: Atender e fazer uma ligação ("This is...", "Can I speak to...?"), deixar e anotar um recado e combinar de ligar de volta.

teacher.goal_pt: Introduzir o jeito de se identificar ao telefone com "This is...".
prompts: Do you prefer calling or texting?
Who do you call most often?
watchFor: "Here is Carlos" ou "I am Carlos" ao telefone (do "aqui é o Carlos"); o natural é "This is Carlos".
"Who speaks?" (do "quem fala?"); o certo é "Who's calling?".

exercises.prompt: Hello, this is Marina. Can I speak to Paul, please?
accepted: Hello, this is Marina. Can I speak to Paul, please?
Hello, this is Marina. Could I speak to Paul, please?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao telefone, "aqui é" vira "this is": "This is Marina".
commonErrors.correction_en: Hello, this is Marina.

exercises.instruction_pt: Você atende o telefone no trabalho e quer saber quem está ligando. O que você diz?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Who's calling, please?" é o jeito educado. "Who speaks?" é tradução literal de "quem fala?", e "Who are you?" soa rude.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ao telefone, diga em inglês: "Oi, aqui é o Pedro."
accepted: Hi, this is Pedro
Hello, this is Pedro
Hi, it's Pedro
Hello, it's Pedro
Hi, Pedro here
Hi, this is Pedro speaking
Hello, Pedro speaking

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Aqui é" ao telefone é "This is" ou "It's": "Hi, this is Pedro".
commonErrors.correction_en: Hi, this is Pedro.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I'm Pedro" é para se apresentar pessoalmente. Ao telefone dizemos "This is Pedro".
commonErrors.correction_en: Hi, this is Pedro.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender as expressões do telefone: hold on, call back, hang up, take a message, the line is busy.
prompts: What do you say when you need a moment?
What do you do when the line is busy?
watchFor: "Turn off" para "desligar a ligação"; "turn off" é desligar o aparelho. Encerrar a ligação é "hang up".
"I'll call to you" com "to"; o certo é "I'll call you".

exercises.example_en: Hold on a second, I'll get her.

exercises.meaning_pt: ligar de volta, retornar a ligação
exercises.example_en: Can you call me back in ten minutes?
Please don't hang up. I'm transferring you now.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada expressão ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "Eu te ligo de volta mais tarde."
accepted: I'll call you back later
I will call you back later
I'll call you later
I'll call back later
I'll give you a call later
I'll ring you back later
Let me call you back later

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Call" vai direto com a pessoa, sem "to": "I'll call you".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll call you back later.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ligar" para alguém é "call". "Connect" é conectar.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll call you back later.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para uma decisão na hora, use "I'll": "I'll call you back later".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll call you back later.

teacher.goal_pt: Soletrar nomes e e-mails com clareza: as letras que brasileiros confundem (e/i, g/j, a/e) e o "at" e "dot".
prompts: Can you spell your name, please?
watchFor: Dizer "i" (português) para a letra E; em inglês E soa "ii" e I soa "ai".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. Em inglês, "@" é "at" e "." é "dot".
exercises.prompt: My email is ana at mail dot com.
accepted: My email is ana at mail dot com
My email address is ana at mail dot com

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O "@" em inglês é "at".
commonErrors.correction_en: My email is ana at mail dot com.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O ponto do e-mail é "dot", e não "point".
commonErrors.correction_en: My email is ana at mail dot com.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita devagar. Hold on é "rôuld-ón", com o "h" soprado.
exercises.prompt: Hold on, please. I'll put you through.
accepted: Hold on, please. I'll put you through
Hold on, please. I will put you through

exercises.instruction_pt: Como soa a letra "E" quando você soletra em inglês?
exercises.explanation_pt: A letra E soa "ii". A letra I é que soa "ai". É fácil trocar as duas ao soletrar.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma ligação curta e responder às frases mais comuns do telefone.
watchFor: Responder "Can I take a message?" com "Yes" sem dar o recado.
"Say him to call me"; o certo é "Tell him to call me" ou "Ask him to call me".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a mensagem de voz e escolha o recado.
exercises.listen: Hi Tom, it's Julia. I'm calling about the meeting tomorrow. It's at ten, not at nine. Call me back when you can. Bye!
options: A reunião de amanhã é às dez, não às nove.
A reunião de amanhã foi cancelada.
A reunião é hoje às nove.
exercises.explanation_pt: "It's at ten, not at nine": a reunião é às dez. Ela pede "Call me back": me ligue de volta.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e deixe um recado: peça para ele te ligar de volta.
exercises.listen: I'm sorry, Mr. Smith isn't here right now. Can I take a message?
accepted: Yes, please ask him to call me back
Yes, can you ask him to call me back?
Yes, could you ask him to call me back?
Can you ask him to call me back?
Could you ask him to call me back, please?
Please ask him to call me back
Yes, please tell him to call me back
Can you tell him to call me back?
Yes, please. Could you ask him to call me back?
Yes, please ask him to call me
Yes, ask him to call me back, please

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Diga a ele" é "tell him" (ou "ask him"). "Say" não vem com a pessoa logo depois.
commonErrors.correction_en: Could you ask him to call me back?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "ask him" vem "to": "ask him to call me back".
commonErrors.correction_en: Could you ask him to call me back?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Me ligar" é "call me". "Connect" é conectar.
commonErrors.correction_en: Could you ask him to call me back?

exercises.instruction_pt: A ligação está ruim. Peça para a pessoa repetir, de forma educada.
exercises.listen: So the delivery will arrive at around three o'clock on Thursday.
accepted: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
Sorry, can you repeat that, please?
Could you repeat that, please?
Can you repeat that, please?
Sorry, could you say that again?
Sorry, can you say that again, please?
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?
Sorry, the line is bad. Could you repeat that?
Pardon?
Sorry?
Could you say that again, please?
Sorry, could you repeat, please?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Repeat" já quer dizer de novo, então não precisa de "again". Diga "repeat that" ou "say that again".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Só "What?" soa rude. Prefira "Sorry?" ou "Could you repeat that, please?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?

teacher.goal_pt: Fazer uma ligação completa: se identificar, pedir para falar com alguém, deixar recado e se despedir.
prompts: Good morning, ABC Company. How can I help you?
I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Would you like to leave a message?
Can I have your number, please?
watchFor: "I want to talk with Mr. Brown"; o mais educado é "Could I speak to Mr. Brown, please?".
Dizer o telefone número por número sem pausas; agrupar ajuda: "five five five, two one, three four".
"I'm calling for to ask" em vez de "I'm calling to ask".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu poderia falar com a Sra. Brown, por favor?"
accepted: Could I speak to Mrs. Brown, please?
Can I speak to Mrs. Brown, please?
May I speak to Mrs. Brown, please?
Could I speak with Mrs. Brown, please?
Can I speak with Mrs. Brown, please?
Could I talk to Mrs. Brown, please?
Could I speak to Ms. Brown, please?
I'd like to speak to Mrs. Brown, please

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I want" soa seco ao telefone. Prefira "Could I speak to...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Could I speak to Mrs. Brown, please?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta a preposição: "speak to" ou "speak with".
commonErrors.correction_en: Could I speak to Mrs. Brown, please?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Estou ligando para confirmar a reserva."
accepted: I'm calling to confirm the reservation
I am calling to confirm the reservation
I'm calling to confirm my reservation
I'm calling to confirm the booking
I'm calling to confirm my booking
I'm phoning to confirm the reservation
I'm calling about my reservation. I want to confirm it

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Finalidade em inglês é "to" + verbo: "I'm calling to confirm".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm calling to confirm the reservation.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ligando" (telefonando) é "calling".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm calling to confirm the reservation.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a pergunta.
accepted: Would you like to leave a message

exercises.instruction_pt: Você liga para um consultório, mas a recepcionista diz que o Dr. Lee não pode atender. Deixe um recado completo.
exercises.prompt_en: Good afternoon, City Clinic. I'm sorry, Dr. Lee is with a patient right now. Would you like to leave a message?
guidelines_pt: Diga quem é: "Yes, please. This is...".
Diga o motivo: "I'm calling about / to...".
Peça para retornarem e dê o seu número: "Could he call me back? My number is...".

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as frases do telefone e o vocabulário de ligação.
prompts: How do you answer the phone at work?
What do you say before you hang up?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Não desligue, por favor."
accepted: Please don't hang up
Please do not hang up
Don't hang up, please
Please hold on
Hold on, please
Please stay on the line
Please hold

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Desligar" a ligação é "hang up". "Turn off" é desligar o aparelho.
commonErrors.correction_en: Please don't hang up.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ordem negativa começa com "Don't": "Don't hang up".
commonErrors.correction_en: Please don't hang up.

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a palavra que falta.
exercises.sentence: Sorry, the line is ___. Please call again later.
accepted: busy
engaged

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A linha está ocupada" é "the line is busy" (ou "engaged", no Reino Unido).
commonErrors.correction_en: The line is busy.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ao telefone, alguém diz "Speaking!". O que isso quer dizer?
options: Sou eu, é ele/ela mesmo quem está falando.
exercises.explanation_pt: Quando perguntam "Can I speak to Ana?" e é a própria Ana, ela responde "Speaking!": "é ela".

exercises.prompt: Thanks for calling. Talk to you soon!
accepted: Thanks for calling. Talk to you soon
Thank you for calling. Talk to you soon
